en: A black‑and‑white postcard image of a large two‑story wooden Victorian house with a wrap‑around porch and decorative columns. The house stands on a well‑kept lawn with a straight walkway leading from the foreground to the entrance. Mature trees, shrubs, and ornamental grasses surround the property, and fluffy clouds fill the sky. The edges of the card show wear and a vertical crack through the image. On the right border there are handwritten or printed numbers running vertically.
